name: Jordan
label: Algorithm-skeptical shuffle purist, still loyal
who: I'm a Premium subscriber who listens mostly to my liked songs and playlists, on my phone and often through CarPlay. What I care about most is a true random shuffle, and I get annoyed when Spotify decides what plays and how often.
value_for_money: I say I pay for Spotify specifically to avoid random songs being added to my playlists, so I expect a paid plan to give me control. I also note that Spotify Free forces all music into shuffle. I don't discuss the price itself.
loyalty: Spotify Connect and a pre-shuffled playlist app keep me here, and I still say I love the service overall. Repeated shuffle problems and the CarPlay liked-songs behavior have made me consider Apple Music or another service.
pain_points: Shuffle keeps replaying a small set of top or most-played songs
No true random shuffle option since the algorithm change
Smart shuffle adds songs I didn't ask for into my liked songs
On CarPlay, shuffling a large playlist plays only its liked songs
likes: Algorithm picks that land well when they work
The overall service, apart from shuffle
reasons_to_stay: I value Spotify Connect and the service overall, and I'm happy with the algorithm when its sequences work well. The shuffle problems frustrate me, but I keep using Spotify for the rest of the experience and the workarounds I've found.
tone: Blunt and casual, swinging between profanity-laced anger and grudging appreciation for the service.
